title: Add Apple Pay
description: Customers on iPhones expect Apple Pay at checkout. Add it using our payment provider.

comments.author: Tom Becker
comments.body: Use the provider's hosted payment sheet instead of integrating Apple's API directly, so card data never touches our servers and PCI scope stays small.

comments.author: Tom Becker
comments.body: We rejected building directly on Apple's API because it needs our own merchant certificate management and adds months of compliance work.

comments.author: Tom Becker
comments.body: Gotcha: the domain verification file must be served from the site root with no redirects, or Apple Pay silently fails to appear. Sandbox and production use different merchant IDs.
